rows.en: ＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００１Oh?￥Do you need the Comm Center too?
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００２I've got a call from Sophia too.＝＠０７５＿００３Probably from my little sister.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００４It's been so long since I saw￥her face, I'm just thrilled!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００５Not to brag, but my little￥sister is super cute!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００６Oh, all right. Just this once,￥I'll let you meet her!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００７Well, I can't blame you for￥thinking that... But!￥She really is that cute!!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７５＿００８You'll see when you meet her.￥Come on, come with me!!
＊Sakaki＊＠０７５＿００９Natsuno, I've been waiting...￥Oh, you brought a friend today.
＊Sakaki＊＠０７５＿０１０It's from the usual hospital,￥but it seems they're calling on￥the emergency-only line.
＊Doctor＊＠０７５＿０１３This is an emergency call from￥Sophia Central General Hospital.
＊Doctor＊＠０７５＿０１４Your sister Haruka's condition￥worsened last night. She is now￥in intensive care in the ICU.
＊Doctor＊＠０７５＿０１５To be frank, she is in very￥serious danger.
＊Doctor＊＠０７５＿０１６Our medical staff are doing￥everything we can... but the￥situation remains critical.＝＠０７５＿０１７Should her condition change, we￥will contact you on this￥emergency line again.
＊Sakaki＊...＝＠０７５＿０２４I hear her sister has always￥been frail...＝＠０７５＿０２５That must have been a real￥shock...
－　Common Floor　－＝－　Natsuno stands there, dazed　－
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿００１I had no idea...￥that she'd gotten￥so much worse...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿００５I can't even be by her side at a￥time like this...￥Some big sister I am.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿００６But if I go back to Sophia,￥I'll lose my place as￥a candidate...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿００８Yeah...￥That's all I can do right now.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿００９Even if I went home, there's￥nothing I could do for her...￥I'm not a doctor...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０１０And I can't just throw away my￥place as a candidate.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０１１My sister is fighting all on her￥own. So I have to keep fighting￥here, too...
Bet you want to go home.
Bet you want to go home.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０１４Honestly...￥I want to rush home right now.

＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０１７But going back now wouldn't help￥my sister, or me...＝＠０７６＿０１８If I really care about her... if￥I think about what comes after￥she pulls through...＝＠０７６＿０１９I absolutely shouldn't go back￥to Sophia!＝＠０７６＿０２０And still...＝＠０７６＿０２１I can't stop wanting to go￥home... I'm so pathetic...
＊Natsuno＊...＝＠０７６＿０２３It's not that I'm blaming￥myself. It's just...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０２４But thanks to you,￥I feel like I've woken up...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０２５Thank you.＝＠０７６＿０２６You're right. Panicking won't￥get me anywhere.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７６＿０２７Look at me, having someone￥younger talk sense into me...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００３You're right. I'm sorry.￥I lost it there...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００４Yeah...￥Whether I'm there or not,￥I'm sure she'll be all right.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００５Look at me, having someone￥younger talk sense into me...
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００６I, more than anyone, should￥believe she'll pull through.
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００７I can't do anything for her by￥going back... so I have to do￥what I can, right here!
＊Natsuno＊＠０７７＿００９My parents must be worried too,￥so I'll give them a call.＝＠０７７＿０１０At a time like this, I'm the one￥who has to cheer my family up!
